'''News from the Underworld: Vol. 1, Issue 1''' was a [[Wikipedia:press release|press release]] issued in [[October]] [[2006]] from [[Petroglyph]] Games to various ''[[Star Wars]]'' fansites and gaming websites. The press release was intended to promote the release of their video game, ''[[Star Wars: Empire at War: Forces of Corruption]]''.
